abstract: This study examines the effects of special economic zones (SEZs) on firm growth and the regional business environment in Viet Nam, highlighting their key role as a policy tool to attract foreign investors. Using detailed panel data from Viet Nam’s 63 provinces from 2006 to 2020 and instrumental variables (IV) estimations, this study provides new insights into how SEZs impact firm growth and several dimensions of economic governance. SEZs are found to play a dual role. Provinces with broader SEZ coverage experienced increases in employment, revenues, and the number of foreign-invested enterprises. In contrast, domestic private firms faced declines in both revenues and numbers. SEZ exposure had negative effects on several aspects of provincial economic governance including land access, transparency in policy-making, and informal charges. In addition, the approval of the first SEZ was also associated with increased prevalence of informal charges and preferential treatment of foreign-invested enterprises and other big companies, which may indicate heightened inefficiencies and rent-seeking concerns.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了越南经济特区（SEZs）对企业增长及区域营商环境的影响，凸显其作为吸引外资政策工具的关键作用。基于2006至2020年越南63个省份的详细面板数据，并采用工具变量（IV）估计方法，本研究揭示了经济特区如何影响企业增长及经济治理的多个维度。研究发现，经济特区发挥着双重作用。经济特区覆盖范围更广的省份，其就业、收入及外商投资企业数量均有所增长。相比之下，国内私营企业的收入与数量均出现下降。经济特区的设立对省级经济治理的若干方面产生了负面影响，包括土地获取、政策制定透明度及非正规收费。此外，首个经济特区的获批还与外商投资企业及其他大型企业非正规收费增加及优惠待遇加剧相关，这可能表明效率低下与寻租问题日益突出。
title: The Role of Special Economic Zones in Shaping Viet Nam’s Local Business Environment

abstract: This paper evaluates a socio-emotional skills training programme for 4,728 urban Tanzanian youth who were not in full-time employment, education, or training. A randomized design compared awareness (for example, self-awareness, empathy, and active listening), management (for example, self-control, personal initiative, and negotiation), and combined curricula. Socio-emotional skills were measured using self-reported and behavioral indicators. Training increased self-reported socio-emotional skills in the short run across both domains, but had limited effects on behavioral measures, and all socio-emotional skills gains faded after one year. Modest but sustained employment gains were observed among men who were job seekers at baseline. Training did not improve labor market outcomes for women. No differential effects were found across training types, and each training affected skills in the alternative domain, suggesting that socio-emotional skills domains are interrelated. These findings indicate that socio-emotional skills training may improve labor market outcomes only for specific subgroups, particularly in the absence of complementary interventions tackling barriers to employment.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了一项针对坦桑尼亚4,728名未处于全职就业、教育或培训状态的城市青年的社会情感技能培训项目。采用随机设计，比较了认知（例如自我认知、同理心和积极倾听）、管理（例如自我控制、个人主动性和谈判）以及综合课程的效果。社会情感技能通过自我报告和行为指标进行测量。培训在短期内提高了两个领域的自我报告社会情感技能，但对行为指标的影响有限，且所有社会情感技能的提升在一年后均消失。在基线时为求职者的男性中观察到适度但持续的就业改善。培训未能改善女性的劳动力市场结果。不同培训类型之间未发现差异化效应，且每种培训均影响了另一领域的技能，这表明社会情感技能领域相互关联。这些发现表明，社会情感技能培训可能仅对特定亚群体改善劳动力市场结果，尤其是在缺乏解决就业障碍的补充干预措施的情况下。

abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 marked the beginning of one of the most consequential episodes in the history of global trade. The subsequent surge in Chinese exports–often referred to as the "China Shock"–has been widely associated with large adjustments in production patterns, labor markets, and trade balances across the global economy (Autor et al. 2016; Pierce and Schott 2016).

abstract: In this paper, we analyse the determinants of maritime connections, with a special focus on the importance of foreign direct investments (FDI) in improving maritime transportation networks and in restructuring them. We are also interested in how China, in particular, impacts countries' integration to global supply chains through maritime transportation. We work on a heterogeneous panel of bilateral maritime connections as measured by UNCTAD's bilateral liner shipping connectivity index, and we find that FDIs between two partner countries do not significantly impact their maritime connection. However, we do find that Chinese FDIs in countries concerned by the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) reinforce bilateral maritime connections between countries, in general, be they BRI countries or not. The Chinese influence is also significant via their maritime presence: maritime connections between two countries are significantly higher when host countries have strong maritime ties to China. A deeper analysis through several interaction effects also shows the Chinese influence is conditional on host countries' attributes. For instance, a maritime connection with China is more beneficial to developing/poorer host countries, who see their connection to origin countries increase more as compared to developed/richer host countries.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了海上连接的决定因素，特别关注外国直接投资在改善海上运输网络及其结构调整中的重要性。我们还重点研究了中国如何通过海上运输影响各国融入全球供应链。基于联合国贸发会议双边班轮航运连接指数衡量的异质性双边海上连接面板数据，我们发现两国之间的外国直接投资并未显著影响其海上连接。然而，中国在“一带一路”倡议相关国家的直接投资普遍加强了各国（无论是否为“一带一路”国家）之间的双边海上连接。中国的海上存在也产生了显著影响：当东道国与中国有紧密的海上联系时，两国之间的海上连接显著更高。通过多种交互效应的深入分析表明，中国的影响取决于东道国的特征。例如，与中国建立海上连接对发展中国家/较贫穷的东道国更为有利，这些国家与来源国的连接提升幅度大于发达国家/较富裕的东道国。

abstract: Economic and political decisions are increasingly made in international organizations (IOs). A distinctive feature of many IOs is that they operate under a system of rotating leadership (e.g. a committee chair that rotates annually). Despite the widespread use of such systems and their potential value to interest groups, we know surprisingly little about how interest groups respond to rotating leadership in IOs. Using both micro- and macro-level data on the economic performance of commercial lobbyists in the European Union, I show that interest groups respond strategically to short-term shifts in leadership. Specifically, when a country takes over the rotating EU Council Presidency, interest groups increase their use of commercial lobbyists to gain access to policymakers from the presiding country.
abstract_zh: 经济与政治决策越来越多地在国际组织（IOs）中作出。许多国际组织的一个显著特征是，它们采用轮值领导制度（例如，委员会主席每年轮换）。尽管这种制度被广泛采用，且对利益集团具有潜在价值，但我们对利益集团如何应对国际组织中的轮值领导制度知之甚少。利用欧盟商业游说者经济表现的微观与宏观层面数据，我揭示了利益集团会策略性地应对短期领导权更迭。具体而言，当一个国家接任欧盟理事会轮值主席国时，利益集团会增加对商业游说者的使用，以获取与主席国政策制定者接触的渠道。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Lobbying and rotating leadership
title_zh: 游说与轮值领导

abstract: Robo-advisors are tools in financial markets that provide investors with low-cost financial advice, typically based on individual characteristics such as risk attitudes. We study the benefits of robo-advice in a ten-week portfolio choice experiment. Depending on treatment, investors either receive robo-advice, have a robo-advisor implement recommendations by default, or invest on their own. While we observe no effect of robo-advice on initial market participation, we find positive effects on continued participation. Robo-advisors also help investors avoid mistakes, increase rebalancing, and yield portfolios closer to the utility-maximising benchmark. Default implementation of recommendations performs significantly better than advice alone.
abstract_zh: 机器人投顾是金融市场中为投资者提供低成本财务建议的工具，通常基于风险态度等个人特征。我们通过一项为期十周的投资组合选择实验，研究了机器人投顾的益处。根据实验处理方式的不同，投资者或接受机器人投顾建议，或由机器人投顾默认执行推荐方案，或自行投资。虽然我们未观察到机器人投顾对初始市场参与的影响，但发现其对持续参与具有积极效应。机器人投顾还能帮助投资者避免错误、增加再平衡操作，并使投资组合更接近效用最大化的基准水平。相较于仅提供建议，默认执行推荐方案的效果显著更优。
title: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
title_zh: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处

abstract: Savings behavior is governed by innate predispositions (nature) and environmental conditions (nurture); yet prior research largely examines these forces in isolation. Leveraging China’s send-down movement—a policy shock that exposed urban youths to adversity—and a twins design exploiting genetic differences between monozygotic and dizygotic pairs, we identify nature-nurture interplay. Applying extended twin-based variance components models to representative data, we find that adversity more than triples genetic influence on savings, increasing its variance share from 15.2 percent among the unexposed to 53.4 percent among the exposed. Results challenge conventional fixed-effects models which assume time-invariant unobserved traits (e.g., genetic endowments) exert linearly additive effects, and demonstrate policy effectiveness hinges on interactions with such traits.
abstract_zh: 储蓄行为受先天禀赋（天性）与后天环境（教养）共同支配，然而既有研究多将二者割裂分析。本研究借助中国"上山下乡"运动——一项使城市青年暴露于逆境的政策冲击——结合双胞胎设计（利用同卵与异卵双胞胎的遗传差异），识别天性-教养的交互作用。通过将扩展的双胞胎方差成分模型应用于代表性数据，我们发现逆境使储蓄行为的遗传影响提升逾两倍，其方差占比从未经历逆境群体的15.2%跃升至经历逆境群体的53.4%。该结果挑战了传统固定效应模型（该模型假设未观测特质如遗传禀赋呈线性可加效应），并证明政策有效性取决于其与这类特质的交互作用。

abstract: This paper explores the relationship between geographic mortality differentials and human capital investment patterns in the Malthusian setup of 19th-century Armenia. We examine how variations in altitude are associated with mortality rates, human capital accumulation, and fertility decisions. Using detailed historical census and parish records, we document that higher-altitude areas tend to have lower population density, lower respiratory disease mortality, and lower overall mortality. Our empirical analysis also shows that individuals in these environments tend to display better numeracy skills and lower fertility rates. These findings align with the Ben-Porath hypothesis, suggesting that longer life horizons encourage shifting from child quantity to quality. Furthermore, these patterns are not driven by income differences or increased female autonomy arising from pastoral agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了19世纪亚美尼亚马尔萨斯式环境下，地理死亡率差异与人力资本投资模式之间的关系。我们研究了海拔变化如何与死亡率、人力资本积累及生育决策相关联。利用详细的历史人口普查和教区记录，我们发现高海拔地区往往具有较低的人口密度、较低的呼吸系统疾病死亡率以及较低的总体死亡率。实证分析还表明，这些环境中的个体通常表现出更好的计算能力和较低的生育率。这些发现与Ben-Porath假说一致，表明更长的生命预期鼓励从子女数量向质量的转变。此外，这些模式并非由收入差异或牧业农业带来的女性自主权增强所驱动。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Geographic mortality differentials and the quality-quantity trade-off

abstract: The existing literature shows that women are generally more likely than men to pay taxes. However, there is less consensus on gendered responses to interventions designed to boost compliance among non-payers, and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we exploit a field experiment designed to increase property tax compliance to investigate this gender disparity. Because female- and male-led households differ along many dimensions, including preferences, household structure, and economic resources, we interpret the female–male contrast as the joint product of these channels rather than the effect of gender alone. Within this framing, the cross-sectional baseline gap in compliance is descriptive, while the within-gender treatment effects of the experimental messages are causally identified by random assignment. Our findings confirm that taxpayers in female-led households are more diligent in paying taxes than those in male-led households at baseline. Notably, while receiving a deterrence letter encourages women to pay earlier, it does not increase their overall compliance; men, in contrast, show a marked improvement in overall compliance upon receiving the same letter. We also find that the size of the tax bill influences women’s compliance behavior (the likelihood of payment after treatment rises significantly for smaller tax bills) but has no similar effect on men. Survey data targeted at the same population suggest that, although women may be more motivated to pay (they perceive higher enforcement risk and exhibit higher tax morale) they also face tighter liquidity constraints, lower and less stable income, and a stronger perception that the tax is excessive. These patterns are consistent with a simple analytical model that links compliance to tax morale, risk aversion, and budget constraints, and in which liquidity-constrained taxpayers remain at a corner solution unresponsive to enforcement messages. The findings highlight how tax policies and enforcement procedures can exacerbate post-tax income inequality between genders, particularly in low-enforcement contexts where the tax base is weakly correlated with current income.
abstract_zh: 现有文献表明，女性通常比男性更倾向于纳税。然而，关于旨在提高未缴税者合规性的干预措施是否存在性别差异反应，学界尚未达成共识，其潜在机制仍不明确。本研究利用一项旨在提高房产税合规性的实地实验，探究这一性别差异。由于女性主导家庭与男性主导家庭在偏好、家庭结构及经济资源等多个维度存在差异，我们将男女对比解读为这些渠道共同作用的结果，而非单纯性别效应。在此框架下，横截面基线合规差距属于描述性分析，而实验信息在性别内部的处理效应则通过随机分配实现因果识别。研究结果证实，在基线水平上，女性主导家庭的纳税人比男性主导家庭更勤于纳税。值得注意的是，虽然收到威慑信函会促使女性提前缴税，但并未提高其整体合规率；而男性在收到相同信函后，整体合规率显著提升。我们还发现，税额大小影响女性的合规行为（小额税单处理后支付概率显著上升），但对男性无类似效应。针对同一人群的调查数据表明，尽管女性可能更有纳税动机（她们感知到更高的执法风险并表现出更强的纳税道德），但同时也面临更紧的流动性约束、更低且不稳定的收入，以及更强烈的税负过重感知。这些模式与一个将合规性关联至纳税道德、风险规避及预算约束的简单分析模型一致，在该模型中，受流动性约束的纳税人处于角点解状态，对执法信息无反应。研究结果凸显了税收政策与执法程序如何加剧性别间的税后收入不平等，尤其是在税基与当前收入弱相关的低执法环境中。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Willing but unable to pay? Gender, preferences, resources, and tax compliance
title_zh: 愿意但无力支付？性别、偏好、资源与税收遵从

abstract: How will future climate change affect Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in terms of migration and welfare? Can policymakers help SSA adapt to this process? I answer these questions with a quantitative framework that, coupled with rich spatial data and forecasts for the future climate, projects millions of climate migrants and unequal welfare losses across SSA. Investigating migration and trade liberalization as policy tools, I find persistent inequality in welfare losses if only migration barriers in SSA are reduced. Relaxing trade barriers addresses these distributional concerns, as do both policies combined. Yet, the policy mix is less effective in reducing aggregate losses due to inefficiencies arising from congestion externalities.
abstract_zh: 未来气候变化将如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民与福利？政策制定者能否帮助该地区适应这一过程？本文通过构建一个量化分析框架，结合丰富的空间数据与未来气候预测，揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区将出现数百万气候移民及不均衡的福利损失。在将移民与贸易自由化作为政策工具进行研究时发现，若仅降低撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民壁垒，福利损失的不平等现象将持续存在。放松贸易壁垒能够解决这些分配问题，而两项政策组合实施亦能达到同样效果。然而，由于拥挤外部性导致的效率损失，政策组合在减少总体损失方面的有效性有所降低。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Climate Change and Migration: The Case of Africa,
title_zh: 气候变化与移民：非洲案例研究

abstract: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the US and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a stand-alone recession, prices become more informative, and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.
abstract_zh: 股票市场具有双重作用：一方面提供企业基本面信息以优化资源配置，另一方面提供流动性。我们构建了一个两种作用相互影响的框架：若股票被更密集地用于获取流动性，则价格所反映的基本面信息将减少。我们通过结构估计测度了多国股票价格的信息含量，发现当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究该机制的实际经济效应，我们设计策略将股票交易模块嵌入包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型。基于美国数据校准模型后，我们模拟了有无银行业困境伴随的经济衰退情景。在独立衰退中，价格信息含量提升，资源配置改善，使产出损失降低4.4%；若衰退伴随银行业困境，经济主体将更依赖股票市场获取流动性，导致价格信息含量下降与资源配置恶化，使产出损失扩大22%。
title: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期
